name: Nevada

response.rule_text: Agency must respond not later than the end of the fifth business day after receipt (NRS 239.0107).

fees.labor_rule: No fee for determining whether a record is public, searching/retrieving, or staff time (NAC 239.864 per RCFP).
fees.copy_rule: Copy fee may not exceed actual cost unless statute says otherwise (NRS 239.052(1)).
fees.waiver_rule: Discretionary waivers require written policy and posted notice (NRS 239.052(2)).

appeal.rule_text: No administrative review; seek order in district court of county where record is held (NRS 239.011(1)); no filing deadline stated. Supreme Court appeal notice within 30 days of notice of entry of judgment (NRAP 4(a)(1)).

exemptions_citation: NRS 239.010 (list of confidential statutes); NRS 239.001(3) narrow construction
format_rule: Copy may be provided in any medium in which the record is readily available (NRS 239.010(4)); oral or written requests valid.
notes: Silence-as-denial not stated; RCFP says no case authority treats delay as denial. Legislature excluded per LCB memo/NRS 41.071 (RCFP). First 100k chars read only.
